findings.title: With the Coinbase loan switched off (onboarding's "No"), the Dashboard's "Where the coins sit" and "Who holds the coins" count the store's placeholder 1.48 ₿ on Coinbase as the owner's coins, while the goal tile on the same screen counts none.
findings.evidence: Path: src/store/slices/cbLoanSlice.ts:22 hasCbLoan false, :25 cbCollateralBtc 1.48 (the seed; store.md:68 'default 1.48'); src/components/Onboarding/OnboardingModal.tsx:83-86 sets Coinbase's collateral only when the owner answers yes; ViewerHomeView.tsx:144 venueCbBtc = deriveCbCollateral(st.dayLog, st.cbCollateralBtc) (not gated, comment :236-238) feeds VenueBar (:240) and OwnershipBar btcHeld (:250); the goal tile's net coins read planCbCollateralOf (:122 → src/components/Almanac/planRun.ts:48-49, 0 with the loan off). Scan (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts`, seedAndGoto = the e2e's plain seed, no Coinbase fields), simple:dashboard at 390: "Where the coins sit 1.480 ₿ total · STRIKE 0.000 ₿ $0 · 0% · COINBASE 1.480 ₿ $121,360 · 100% · COMBINED 1.480 ₿ … Who holds the coins 1.480 ₿ held · YOURS 1.480 ₿ $121,360 · 100% · OWED 0.000 ₿". Edge E8 (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts --project=w390 edge.spec.ts -g 'E8'`; hasCbLoan false, planGoalNetBtc 1, manual $100,000): "GOAL: Your goal ₿0.000 of ₿1.000 net coins today · 0%" and on the same screen "BARS: Where the coins sit 1.480 ₿ total … COINBASE 1.480 ₿ $148,000 · 100% … Who holds the coins 1.480 ₿ held YOURS 1.480 ₿ $148,000 · 100%"; persisted state {"hasCbLoan":false,"dayLog":0} (cbCollateralBtc is the in-memory default).
findings.whyItMatters: Every install that declines a Coinbase loan is told on its home screen that it holds 1.48 ₿ (~$148k at $100k) it never entered, and "yours" 100% of it; the goal tile right below says ₿0.000 — two figures for the same coins on one screen. A trusted viewer is shown the same. The plan readers exclude this seed by rule (D-R2-4: 'never the fresh install's seed $60,000 on 1.48 ₿'); the Dashboard's bars don't.
findings.fixSketch: Feed the venue and ownership bars Coinbase's coins through planCbCollateralOf (or only a Coinbase collateral the owner recorded), so the bars and the goal tile read one figure.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9's 'the Coinbase leg with the loan off' is the PLAN's leg (almanac.md:1591-1593 — the policy still pledges buys to Coinbase and the after box shows a Coinbase leg); this is the Dashboard's two bars reading the raw seed, which no plan reader takes. Not a zero-state word: it prints 1.48 ₿, not a zero.

findings.title: A Strike balance with no Strike collateral reads as maximally safe in the Strike card's liquidation cushion — "$100,000.00 above liq ~$0.00 · 100% drop away" — beside its own "∞ LTV POOR", and as "Liq at ~$0" on the Dashboard and a trusted viewer's home.
findings.evidence: Path: SafetyDashboard.tsx:101-103 strikeLiqPrice = currentBtcHeld > 0 ? bal/(btc×liqLtv) : 0; :104 strikeDropUsd = max(0, btcPrice − 0) = btcPrice; :105 strikeDropPct = 1; printed at :202. src/simulation/safetyView.ts:395-397 (computeViewerSafety, trusted figures) has the same 0 fallback → ViewerHomeView.tsx:159 "Liq at ~${fmtUSD(f.strike.liqPrice)}". Edge E7 (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts --project=w390 edge.spec.ts -g 'E7'`; advisorActualBlocBalance 1000, creditLine 10000, no Strike collateral, manual $100,000): THIS MONTH, Strike card flipped with ⇄ liquidation → "STRIKE BLOC ∞ LTV POOR EDIT 85% liq ₿0.00000 · $100,000.00 above liq ~$0.00 · 100% drop away · $1,000.00 balance"; Dashboard → "100% Strike BLOC LTV POOR Liq at ~$0 $1,000 balance".
findings.whyItMatters: Debt with nothing behind it is already past liquidation; the cushion says the price could fall 100% first — the inversion test-suite.md:25-28 names ('returning 0 there rendered the worst possible state as perfectly safe'). The level is right; the sentence under it contradicts it, on the Safety card itself.
findings.fixSketch: With debt and no collateral, give no liquidation price ("no collateral — past liquidation") and a 0% drop, in SafetyDashboard and computeViewerSafety alike.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 has 'Safety's amber title naming Coinbase for Strike' (the title) and 'the zero-state words' (an empty position); this is the cushion line on a $1,000 debt.

findings.title: The Living on Bitcoin tab prints a negative net worth as a positive one ("$6,863" for −$6,863) through the sign-dropping fmtUSD, and at zero holdings prints "Real Return -Infinity%", "NaN%", "BTC Held ₿ -0.3556 BTC" and a crash test "LTV: 0% SAFE" on $42,000 of unbacked debt.

Edge E3 (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts --project=w390 edge.spec.ts -g 'E3'`; full mode, income $0, growth −50%): "Max Leverage (Dangerous) $6,863 NET WORTH BTC Held ₿ 0.7000 BTC Amount Drawn $42,000 … Final LTV 120.0% Real Return -109.8% Smart BLOC (Crash-Safe) $9,407 NET WORTH … Final LTV 127.4% Real Return -113.4%"; probe (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probeA4__/a4.probe.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2`, same inputs): maxLev netReal=-6862.75 loc=42000.00. Edge E4 (holdings 0, income $0): "Max Leverage (Dangerous) $41,176 NET WORTH BTC Held ₿ 0.0000 BTC Interest Paid $2,958 Real Return -Infinity% … Sell to Live (No LoC) $52,292 NET WORTH BTC Held ₿ -0.3556 BTC … No Bitcoin (Cash Only) $0 NET WORTH … Real Return NaN% Crash Stress Test BTC price crashes: $150,000 → $30,000 Max Leverage LTV: 0% SAFE … Smart BLOC LTV: 0% SAFE"; probe: netReal=-41176.47 loc=42000 crashLtv=0 realReturn=-Infinity, noBtc realReturn=NaN.
findings.whyItMatters: The tab exists to show when Max Leverage is dangerous; in exactly that case it prints the loss as a positive net worth, and calls $42,000 drawn on no coins SAFE. Reachable with the tab's own sliders (holdings min 0, income min $0, growth min −50%) and the plan's own income and expenses (shared store fields).
findings.fixSketch: Print net worth sign-preserving, show '—' for a return over a zero base, stop Sell to Live at zero coins, and give a zero-collateral debt an infinite crash LTV printed through fmtLtvPct.
findings.notKnownBecause: No §9 item names the Living on Bitcoin tab, its strategy cards or its stress test.

findings.title: Daily's activity row for a Strike balance reading taken with no Strike collateral reads "(0.0% LTV)" once the app reloads ("Infinity% LTV" before), through an open-coded LTV formatter the fmtLtvPct guard can't see.
findings.evidence: Path: dailyView.ts:30 pct = (frac) => `${(frac * 100).toFixed(1)}%`, used for strikeLtv (:68) and cbLtv (:70); src/store/slices/dayLogSlice.ts:118 strikeLtv = computeStrikeLtv(strikeBal, collateral, price) = Infinity at 0 collateral; persist and sync are JSON, which writes Infinity as null; (null*100).toFixed(1) = "0.0". Probe (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probeA4__/a4.probe.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2 -t 'Daily reading'`): live → {"label":"Balance reading","detail":"Strike $1,000.00 (Infinity% LTV)"}; after JSON round trip reading={"strikeBal":1000,"strikeLtv":null,"price":100000} → "Strike $1,000.00 (0.0% LTV)". Edge E6 on screen (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts --project=w390 edge.spec.ts -g 'E6'`): STORED "reading":{"strikeBal":1000,"strikeLtv":null,"price":100000}; ROWS ["Oct 25\nBalance reading\nStrike $1,000.00 (0.0% LTV)"]. The guard (src/utils/__tests__/fmtLtvPct.test.ts:12) needs an identifier containing 'ltv' before '* 100).toFixed' — 'frac' passes it.
findings.whyItMatters: The journal records an unbacked $1,000 Strike balance as 0.0% LTV — the safest reading for the worst state, the inversion CLAUDE.md:47's rule exists to stop; the same row's CB half has the same formatter.
findings.fixSketch: Print a reading's LTVs through fmtLtvPct and read a null LTV as non-finite ('∞' with debt, '—' otherwise), never 0.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9; the docs' exception (test-suite.md:31-33) is for EDITABLE form values, not this read-only row.

findings.title: The Scenario face prints "Strike LTV Infinity% → Infinity% NaNpp", "+Infinitypp" and "Crash LTV … Infinity%" whenever Strike collateral is zero against a Strike balance — a local LTV formatter the guard misses.
findings.evidence: Path: ScenarioFace.tsx:37 pct = (frac) => (frac*100).toFixed(1)+'%', :38 pp; applied at :133-136 and :142 to diffScenarios' strikeLtv/crashLtv (src/simulation/scenarioDiff.ts:97-104, 123; safetyView.ts:199-200 computeStrikeLtv → Infinity; Infinity − Infinity = NaN for the delta). findings.title: The Smart BLOC tab's Custom tier says "Day-one LTV: 0.0% · 80% crash → 0% Safe" for a month's expenses drawn on ₿0.0000 of collateral, and the LTV guard exempts the whole file on a reason ("a ratio of configured constants") that is false for this card.
findings.evidence: Path: TierCards.tsx:28-30 customDayOneLtv = sandboxBtc > 0 && btcPrice > 0 ? expenses/(sandboxBtc×btcPrice) : 0; :31-33 label 'Safe'; printed at :119 ((customDayOneLtv * 100).toFixed(1)) and :124. src/utils/__tests__/fmtLtvPct.test.ts:64-65 drops every grep hit containing 'TierCards' because 'TierCards' day-one LTV is a ratio of configured constants and cannot be non-finite' — true of :69 (the TIERS constants), not of :119 (a computed ratio with a 0 fallback). Scan (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts`), loan seed at 1280, full:tab:Smart BLOC: "CUSTOM ₿ 0.0000 BTC Day-one LTV: 0.0% 80% crash → 0% Safe" (expenses $3,500, Strike collateral 0, so sandboxBtc = getCurrentBtcHeld() = 0).
findings.whyItMatters: The sandbox tells an owner with no Strike collateral that drawing the month's expenses stays Safe through an 80% crash — the 0-for-infinite inversion the LTV rule names — and the guard can never catch this file's next open-coded LTV because its exemption is file-wide.
findings.fixSketch: Make the zero-collateral custom LTV infinite and print it through fmtLtvPct ('∞', 'Liquidated'); narrow the guard's exemption to line 69's constant tiers.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not named in §9. It may brush 'the zero-state words' (an empty Strike collateral), but this is a 'Safe' verdict on a draw and a guard whose stated reason is false, not wording.

findings.title: The Mining face's figures disagree with its words: a negative net prints "$-1.0620", the sats net subtracts electricity under the face's own "100% of mined sats kept", and with no live quote every figure is valued at a hard-coded $80,000 labelled "Live: $80,000".
findings.evidence: Path: format.ts:58-59 fmtMiningUSD: n < 0.01 → '$' + n.toFixed(4) for any negative; src/simulation/miningUtils.ts monthlyNetUSD = gross − elec, its sats = usdToSats(net); src/components/Mining/MiningProjectionTable.tsx:131-139 'NET ACCUMULATED' = gross sats + 'Electricity paid in fiat · 100% of mined sats kept'; rule .claude/rules/ui.md:20 'Mining electricity | Fiat overhead — 100% sats kept, never deducted'; src/hooks/useMiningSimulation.ts:15 btcPriceOverride ?? livePrice ?? 80000; src/components/Mining/MiningInputsPanel.tsx:245 'Live: $' + (livePrice ?? btcPrice). Scan (all three seeds, both widths, Mining face and Miners tool, 60 screens): "Daily EV $0.08 Monthly Net $-1.0620 Yearly Net $-12.7442". Edge E5 sats (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts --project=w390 edge.spec.ts -g 'E5'`): "Daily EV 101 sats Monthly Net -1,328 sats Yearly Net -15,930 sats" beside "⛏ Mined 丰 1,625 sats … NET ACCUMULATED 丰 1,625 sats Electricity paid in fiat · 100% of mined sats kept". Edge E9 (app price manual $100,000, live quote aborted as offline): "BTC Price LIVE MANUAL Live: $80,000". Probe (default fleet at $100,000): usd monthlyNet=$-0.4570 yearlyNet=$-5.4845; sats monthlyNet=-457 sats.
findings.whyItMatters: The default fleet (two Bitaxes at 12¢/kWh) nets negative, so every visit shows a malformed dollar; sats mode deducts what the face and the rule say is never deducted; offline — the PWA's precached mode — a made-up price is labelled live and the owner's manual price is ignored.
findings.fixSketch: Format a negative mining dollar as '−$1.06'; show the sats net without electricity (or label it 'after electricity'); fall back to the store's btcPrice with a word that isn't 'Live'.

findings.title: Cycling, Ownership and Strategy say "This run: $0 over 0 borrows — a blended 2.00% of the amount moved" and that the move "still pays for itself after ~3.6 months at that blended fee" on a run that moved nothing.
findings.evidence: Path: src/components/Almanac/cyclingFaceView.ts:161-165 refinanceFeeFraction falls back to CB_FEE_TIER1_PCT (0.02) when totalRefinancedUsd is 0 (cyclingFaceView.test.ts:168 pins the fallback); CyclingFace.tsx:408-409 feeFraction/feeBreakEvenMonths, :1171-1174 print it as this run's realized blend (OwnershipFace.tsx:1139-1142, UnifiedFace.tsx:966-969 the same). Scan (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts`), loan seed ($50,000 on 1 ₿, policy on), 15 screen visits (Cycling and Ownership faces, both widths, all loan-bearing seeds): "This run: $0 over 0 borrows — a blended 2.00% of the amount moved. The Strike→Coinbase move still pays for itself after ~3.6 months at that blended fee." (text dump simple:face:Cycling line 193).

findings.fixSketch: With no borrows, say 'No sweep to Coinbase on this run' and give the tier-1 fee's break-even as a rate, not as this run's blend.

findings.title: The Ownership (and Strategy) chart's ₿ axis rounds its ticks to one decimal, so a small stack's axis reads "0.0₿ | 0.0₿ | 0.1₿ | 0.1₿ | 0.1₿".
findings.evidence: Path: OwnershipFace.tsx:897 and UnifiedFace.tsx:834 tickFormatter={(x) => `${x.toFixed(1)}₿`}; Recharts' ticks 0, 0.03, 0.06, 0.09, 0.12 round to two pairs of equal labels. Scan (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx playwright test -c scan/playwright.config.ts`), plain seed (seedAndGoto), Ownership face at 390 and 1280 and in full mode: "0 | 2 | 4 | … | 24 | 0.0₿ | 0.0₿ | 0.1₿ | 0.1₿ | 0.1₿".
findings.whyItMatters: Repeated labels make the axis unreadable for any stack under about half a coin — a new owner's.
findings.fixSketch: Choose the tick decimals from the domain's span (2–3 dp under 1 ₿).
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9 ('the zero-state words' are words, not chart ticks; the Decision chart's title is a different chart).

Probe (`cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A4 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probeA4__/a4.probe.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2 -t 'goal tile'`): goalTileView(-0.0001, 1) → {"value":"−₿0.000 of ₿1.000","sub":"net coins today · 0%","aria":"Your goal: minus 0.000 bitcoin in net coins today, of 1.000 — 0%."}; goalNowView(-0.0001, null) → {"value":"₿0.000"}.

The sub-nav (AlmanacView.tsx:96-111) offers 12 faces with a Coinbase loan and a logged month, 11 on seedLoanAndGoto alone (no Ledger), 8 with no loan — E1's minimum count should be 11 on the loan seed, 12 with a logged month.
